_note: The photography manifest: one Unsplash photo id per image slot. `pnpm photos` downloads these, crops them to the slot's aspect ratio, writes the committed WebP files under src/assets/img/, and regenerates content/credits.json from the live metadata so an attribution can never drift from the file it describes.
_licence: Unsplash's free licence permits commercial use and modification with no attribution required. We attribute anyway. The fetch script REFUSES an Unsplash+ (premium) photo, whose licence is different and is not free.
_assets: They live in src/assets/, not public/, so Vite content-hashes them into dist/assets — the one path the deploy workflow serves with `immutable`. A file in public/ would be revalidated on every load forever.
_alt: ⚠️ SWAPPING A PHOTO MEANS REWRITING ITS ALT TEXT. Alt text lives in the translation catalogue (messages/*.json), not here — it is copy, and it is translated like the rest. Nothing links the two.
_shared: The ids are deliberately the same as wanderlane-next's, so the two demos look like one brand. The repositories stay independent: each carries its own manifest and its own copy of the files.
